title: The First Lesson
description: Mo Wuji appears as a shadow. 'Cultivation is not about righteousness—it's about results. Let me show you the first scheme.'

title: Information Gathering
description: Learn to observe without being observed. Every detail is a weapon in the right hands.

title: Schemes within Schemes
description: Mo Wuji forces you to calculate dozens of scenarios where allies betray you. The lesson: never trust appearances, only your own Dao-heart.

title: Resource Optimization
description: Every Gu worm, every spirit stone has maximum utility. Learn to extract 120% value from 100% resources.

title: Emotional Detachment
description: Sentiment is weakness. Learn to cut away emotional attachments that cloud judgment.

title: Manipulation Tactics
description: People are tools. Learn to position them where they serve your cultivation best.

title: Long-term Planning
description: Think in centuries, not years. Your current actions echo through future incarnations.

title: Gu Refinement Principles
description: Learn the art of incremental improvement—each small optimization compounds exponentially.

title: The Final Scheme
description: Mo Wuji presents his ultimate test: orchestrate a complex plan that benefits you while appearing to help others.

title: Graduation
description: You have learned the Dao of Schemes. Mo Wuji nods coldly: 'Remember—eternal life requires eternal vigilance.'
